# Clegra apps

> Clegra's developer platform: apps that are also MCP servers. One thing per file — `defineEntity`, `defineAction`, `definePage`, `defineArtifact`, `defineAgent` handles assembled by `defineApp({ entities: [...], actions: [...], pages: [...] })` and run by `serve(app, { auth, … })`, from the package `@clegra/sdk` — becomes a plain, conformant MCP server with tools, annotations, MCP Apps views and OAuth (for ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP client) a JSON manifest Clegra reads to draw the app natively in its workspace, and an OpenAPI 3.1 index of the same operations. No MCP extension required.

## Start here

- [AI guide](ai-guide.md): the complete single-file reference for coding agents — the whole shape (define* handles, defineApp, serve), the rules, the common mistakes, a full example. Read this one file to build an app.

## More

- [Specification](spec.md): the manifest, kinds and cross-app references, the generated MCP server, enforcement, conformance, the workspace host across apps (normative, short)
- [Getting started: plain JavaScript](start-javascript.md): one file per thing, any runtime with Fetch (Node `listen`, Express); pages, tests, data, kinds
- [Getting started: Next.js](start-next.md): 5 minutes (`npx @clegra/sdk init`), a day to ship
- UI: `@clegra/ui`, a separate package (its own repository and guide): Clegra's components for React and React Native, the theme and `<ClegraProvider>` for an app's own view; `npx @clegra/sdk init --ui` adds it with Tailwind 4
- [Auth](auth.md): the sign-in module (`createSignIn`, `devSignIn`) or your own authorization server with `auth.resolve`; recipes for better-auth, Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS
- [CRM example](examples/crm.md): Next.js, better-auth, Drizzle; code in `examples/crm/clegra/`
- [Warehouse example](examples/warehouse.md): Next.js, better-auth, plain SQL; code in `examples/warehouse/clegra/`
- JSON Schema of the manifest: `spec/schema/clegra.schema.json`
- The kinds of this version (person, organization, event, task, document, product, order): `spec/kinds.json`
